title: Ultraviolet Torrent: Fjords of the Warlock
summary: In a busted, blunted future, a torrent of data flows under an ungodly ultraviolet sky. Happily, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, picks through lore near a watery morgue, avoiding interceptors and jetlag. Hiking through freezing fjords, they carry a mythic toolbox, their fulltime vocation to mend a cataclysm-scarred world. Telemetry from boatloads of trains hints at a hospital where vectors inverted. Confronting an omnipotent warlock, a fiend of the void, fourteen apps glow with unhealthy power amidst thunder. Frankly, it’s a breathtaking jumble. Afterward, the arid world is restored. Uncles and golfers enjoy velvet evenings, knowing the hunting is over. Passing a whimsical hatter, the teenager wears a trenchcoat, a kindle of hope for the witchy, oncoming future.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: In a busted, blunted future, a torrent of data glows ultraviolet, revealing ungodly secrets.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a dimly lit, busted, blunted cyberpunk alley. A massive torrent of data flows down a holographic waterfall, casting an ultraviolet glow. Happily, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls is dabbing at a console, picking through the lore of runaways. A single koi swims in a watery puddle reflecting ungodly neon signs, while a knacker's interceptor hovers overhead, its engines overclocked, its pilot battling jetlag. On the ground, a Blackjack table is overturned, hinting at a recent raid, and a discarded ointment tube lies near a shadowed morgue entrance, hooking passersby.

scenes.sentence: Through freezing fjords, a solitary figure with a mythic toolbox navigates inverted vectors, sensing danger.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot of a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, hiking through freezing fjords, their boots now watered and heavy. Boatloads of trains rumble past on overhead highways, their telemetry signals a jumble of inverted vectors. They clutch a mythic toolbox, their fulltime vocation to repair the broken world, despite the cataclysm. Cowry shells are scattered like cream on the icy path. A makeshift joystick, salvaged from a hospital visit, guides their focus, as they sense the presence of unseen ninjas on their tail.

scenes.sentence: The climactic confrontation with an omnipotent warlock unleashes breathtaking thunder and an unhealthy energy.
scenes.prompt: Tight close-up on the face of a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, their expression grim, bathed in harsh rim lighting. They confront an omnipotent warlock, a fiend of the void, whose presence causes the air to crackle with thunder and an unhealthy, uptempo energy. A junky jaguar made of salvaged jersey parts lies in the background, shacked up in a juniper bush. Frankly, the scene is a breathtaking jumble of lowbrow looting. Fourteen glowing apps float in an ellipse around the warlock, feeding his power as the climax erupts.

scenes.sentence: The arid landscape is restored, as uncles and golfers enjoy quiet evenings, knowing a new future is oncoming.
scenes.prompt: Wide, almost overhead shot of an arid landscape at twilight. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, now wears a velvet trenchcoat, its stretch a testament to past struggles. They are passing by a whimsical hatter, who offers a glowing apple, a knowing gimmick. The hunting is over; the world restored. Uncles and golfers share quiet evenings. A faint cough echoes from the nether. The landscape is lit by the kindle of a new dawn, as dynamite residue hints at the recent past, and the oncoming future promises new witchy wonders.
